fieldNotes.truckGate: Entry off Logistics Center Dr is an open driveway with painted lane arrows but no barrier arm or sliding/swing gate across the lane (Street View 2025-10 + z20 satellite). Truck yard is screened by a tree-line buffer/fence but the entrance itself is uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. The only small structures near the throat are utility cabinets/transformers (green box visible in Street View), not a multi-window guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled gate at all; not a kiosk/app check-in situation.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock banks run along both long faces (NE wall and SW wall), implying physically separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 495,625 SF cross-dock building (LoopNet/C&W); door rhythm visible on both long faces. 50+ band; exact count ~80 is an overhead estimate (roof overexposed in tight crops).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Striped trailer-parking stalls at the SE end of the yard near the highway buffer and at the NE corner; only a handful of trailers parked in current imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open entry apron and deep internal yard give ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate from striped SE/NE stall areas plus deep apron; approximate.
